back: Producing an e.m.f. when a conductor cuts a magnetic field or the field linking it changes.

front: Magnet and coil: what does the meter show?
back: In: deflection one way. Still: zero. Out: opposite deflection. Faster: bigger deflection.
Faster motion, stronger magnet, more turns on the coil.
The induced current opposes the change that produces it.

front: Why must the induced current oppose the change?
back: Conservation of energy: work done against the opposing force becomes electrical energy.
thuMb: Motion. First finger: Field. seCond finger: induced Current.
